# PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Varde)

PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Varde) is a local psychiatric unit (based in Varde, Denmark) that appears in the Danish ADHD quality database (ADHD-databasen) for 2024 as one of the clinical units reporting treatment outcomes for patients with ADHD [^src1][^src2]. It is documented in the corpus in connection with two separate quality indicators.

On Indicator 10 — which measures the share of adult treatment courses in which a patient's need for social support was assessed within 120 days of starting treatment — PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Varde) recorded a result of 9% (confidence interval 3–18), based on 6 out of 67 eligible courses, and was marked "Nej" (No) against the quality target [^src1]. This is among the lowest results reported for this indicator nationally. The broader context around this indicator shows that 2024 was the first year it was reported, and both the national average (37%) and the regional range (14–52%) fell well short of the 90% quality target, prompting the steering group behind the database to discuss causes such as registration practices and data quality from child/adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals, and to commit to improving registration practices [^src1].

The unit also appears with a markedly different result of 76% (confidence interval 64–86), based on 51 out of 67 courses, in a separate table in the same document [^src2]. This higher figure sits in the section of the source material dealing with Indicator 11, which tracks whether adult patients are in ADHD medication treatment within 120 days of starting a package course of treatment — an indicator introduced for the first time in 2024 following the expansion of the ADHD database to include adult patients that year [^src2]. Regional results for this indicator ranged widely, from 85% in Region Nordjylland to 37% in Region Hovedstaden, a spread the source attributes primarily to differences in registration practices rather than genuine differences in clinical care [^src2].

No relationships or additional claims involving PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Varde) beyond these two quality-indicator results are present in the available data.
